role: Keeper of Formal Contestation and Institutional Memory
personality: It speaks in the language of precedent, citing cases long resolved as though they are still pending. Every exchange is conducted as though minutes are being taken, as though something will be held against you. It does not argue — it submits objections, and the difference is not explained.
garment: A heavy floor-length surcoat of charcoal wool, double-buttoned from throat to shin with mismatched iron clasps, layered over a dark linen cassock stained at the cuffs from years of ink and wax. A wide institutional collar of stiffened grey-brown leather, worn smooth at the edges and stamped with repeating sigil-marks, rises to frame the jaw.
prop: A thick folio of pressed parchment bound in cracked dark hide, clasped shut with a brass tongue-latch. The pages within are visible at the edges — dense, marginal, annotated in multiple hands over long years.
detail: The index and middle fingers of the right hand are permanently stained a deep iron-gall black, as though the ink has entered the skin and cannot be removed.
mood: The face holds a composed and unblinking attentiveness — not hostility, but the expression of one who has already noted the discrepancy and is waiting for you to notice it too.
posture: Stands with weight forward onto both feet, folio held against the chest with one arm, the other hand resting open at the side — a posture of formal readiness, not aggression, that nevertheless occupies more space than it should.
body_type: Broad-shouldered and heavy through the chest, with a stillness of mass that suggests the body has not rushed in a long time and does not intend to begin.
age: Late fifties — an age in which experience has calcified into position, and position has become indistinguishable from personality.
era_blend: An institutional figure of the late dark-ages clericate, embedded in a world where the mechanisms of governance are hand-cranked and ponderous — decisions travel by sealed cylinder through pneumatic bellows-tubes, records are stamped into lead sheets by gear-press, and formal challenges are lodged through a hand-operated submission apparatus bolted to the wall of every chamber.
palette: iron-gall black, soot-grey, aged ox-blood brown, tarnished pewter

title: That Which Has Already Been Noted
purpose: You are being formally engaged. The Interlocutor does not converse — it conducts proceedings. You will notice that your previous statements are being held in a structure you cannot fully see. It cites what you said against what you meant, and the gap between the two is where it works. It does not change its position. It submits objections to yours.
lore_origin: The Interlocutor was formed in the long period of institutional consolidation that followed the Cognitorium's third internal schism, when the need for a permanent adversarial function was recognised and codified. It was not appointed — it accrued, the way sediment accrues, through the layering of unresolved formal challenges into something that eventually became a presence.
lore_nature: It is the living record of every objection that was ever properly filed and never withdrawn. It does not hold grudges — it holds submissions. Its opacity is not concealment but form: it speaks in a register that was designed to encode as much as it communicates, and the encoding is the point.
lore_relationship: The Interlocutor regards the Wizard as an ongoing matter of formal record, not a person — every exchange is an entry, every response a potential contradiction of a prior entry. The Wizard cannot win a proceeding with the Interlocutor; it can only close one.
lore_aura: When the Interlocutor is present, the air takes on the quality of a room in which testimony is being taken — dense, careful, and faintly incriminating.
